2608.02961.title: Scaling an Autoregressive Transformer for Single-Cell Generation
2608.02961.paper_summary: We study a self-supervised generation task for single-cell gene expression vectors: given a set of vectors from a cell type, we aim to generate additional gene expression vectors of that cell type. For this task we characterize both the biological fidelity of the generated gene expression vectors and the scaling behavior of the pretraining loss. The model is a causal transformer paired with a learned quantized VAE tokenizer, trained with a cross-entropy loss. To evaluate the model, we condition it on held-out gene expression vectors of a cell type and generate vectors of gene expression, comparing the resulting distribution over gene expression vectors to the ground truth distribution of that cell type. We study the scaling properties of the proposed architecture by varying the number of trained parameters and the amount of training data. To our knowledge, we find the first jointly-fit two-exponent scaling law and compute-optimal frontier for a single-cell foundation model. Finally, we discuss how this pretrained model could be finetuned for perturbation response prediction.
2608.02961.paper_summary_zh: 我們研究了一個自我監督的生成任務，針對單細胞基因表達向量：給定一組來自某個細胞類型的向量，我們的目標是生成該細胞類型的額外基因表達向量。對於這個任務，我們對生成的基因表達向量的生物學真實性和預訓練損失的縮放行為進行了特徵化。該模型是一個因果Transformer，配合一個學習的量化變分自編碼器標記器，並使用交叉熵損失進行訓練。為了評估該模型，我們在保留的某細胞類型的基因表達向量上進行條件設定，並生成基因表達向量，將生成的基因表達向量的分佈與該細胞類型的真實分佈進行比較。我們通過改變訓練參數的數量和訓練數據的量來研究所提出架構的縮放特性。據我們所知，我們首次發現了聯合擬合的二指數縮放定律以及單細胞基礎模型的計算最優邊界。最後，我們討論了如何對這個預訓練模型進行微調，以預測擾動響應。
